articles.title: Reports of privatisation ‘baseless and incorrect’: ISRO
articles.summary: India's premier space agency, ISRO, has categorically denied recent reports of its privatization, labeling them "baseless and incorrect." This official statement, issued on Sunday, aims to address significant internal anxieties and concerns among its employees who had sought clarification. The denial serves to reassure staff and clarify the organization's future operational structure amidst broader discussions about increasing private sector participation in India's space ecosystem.
